note: Public changes to the registry and site. Each entry is a commit on the public repository's main branch; the commit and its message are the record. Counts are those of data/evidence.json and data/ontology.json at that commit.

entries.title: Registry v0.3.0: AI deployment evidence
changes: Rules for operational and pilot claims: the basis must be stated, the operator named separately from any provider or developer, and outcomes are never recorded as facts.
First AI application recorded as operational (Idarati AI), on the basis of public availability only; use is not documented.
Health and financial-services entries, recorded as announced.
Questions page: deployments, operators, evidence recency, unresolved entries.
A separate source checker that re-fetches sources without changing data.
corrections: DeepEcho software changed from in development to unresolved: the FDA record contradicts the company website's disclaimer, now marked superseded.
FDA wording corrected to 510(k) clearance; the applicant's link to the Moroccan company recorded as an association, not a legal identity.
A provider attribution for Idarati AI (Berexia) removed: the label appears only in interface text and is not shown on the assistant.

entries.title: Registry v0.2.0: companies, models, datasets and lifecycle stages
changes: AI companies, open models and datasets, and compute infrastructure.
Lifecycle stages for projects, models and datasets, each backed by a record that declares the stage.
First version of the questions page.
corrections: The higher-education ministry recorded as a signatory of the Nador memorandum, on a new source naming the signatories.
The DarijaBERT developer link reclassified as independent analysis: the model card names "AIOX Lab", and identification is by name.
UM6P Ventures' origin set to unresolved; Toubkal recorded as compute infrastructure, not as an AI application.

entries.title: Registry v0.1.0: evidence registry, ontology and quality gates
changes: Evidence registry and ontology with claim classifications, a validator and automated quality gates.
Generated registry pages, an independence statement on every page and self-hosted fonts.
corrections: False capability claims and placeholder links on the original homepage corrected.
The CNDP recorded as listing Law 09-08 in its regulatory framework, not as administering it.
Conventions signed for the creation of Jazari institutes no longer presented as constituted institutions.

entries.title: Site created
changes: Initial single-page site published at themoroccoai.com.
